title: Richard Sakala v The Attorney General (2024/CCZ/0014) [2025] ZMCC 8 (1 April 2025)
case_name: Richard Sakala v The Attorney General
issue_tags: preliminary objection on point of law
outcome_detail: Majority (4:1) — petition dismissed; petitioner failed without reasonable explanation to institute petition promptly (slept on rights for over twenty years), contrary to Article 118(2)(b). Mwandenga JC dissenting (would have allowed petition to be heard on merits). Parties to bear own costs
dissent_summary: Mwandenga JC dissented, finding the motion has no merit and would dismiss it with no order as to costs (would allow petition to be heard on merits); cautioned majority against introducing three additional elements amounting to amending Article 128(3) which would step into Parliament's legislative mandate under Article 62
